pois.label: 金水河与白石桥
pois.label_en: Golden Water River and marble bridges
pois.detail: 三座白石桥跨过南端水带。中央桥衔接御道，桥头以细踏步过渡；水面使用真实屋顶几何生成的静态环境反射，具有近似视差，并非逐池平面镜像。
pois.detail_en: Three marble bridges span the southern waterway. Small approach steps connect the central bridge to the avenue. A static environment captured from actual roof geometry supplies approximate reflections, not per-pool planar mirrors.
pois.sim: 程序化幻想建筑；水面反射不是流体或光学精确仿真。
pois.sim_en: Procedural fantasy architecture; water reflections are not a validated fluid or optical simulation.

pois.label: 贯通御道
pois.detail: 中轴线上不设置门楼、走廊或器物。五组仪门体量分列东西两侧，中央只保留桥面、铺地、平台与白石阶，直达主殿前台基。检查路径来自实际几何表面。
pois.detail_en: No gatehouse, corridor or ornament occupies the central axis. Five paired gateway volumes flank it; bridges, paving, landings and marble stairs lead to the summit podium. Inspection heights are derived from the emitted geometry.
pois.sim: 网格连续性验收不等同于主城第一人称碰撞控制器已完成接入。
pois.sim_en: Mesh continuity validation does not imply that the main viewer's first-person collision controller has been integrated.

pois.label: 九层红墙台地
pois.detail: 九层逐级收分的台地构成向山顶聚拢的轮廓。朱红墙身、黄色压檐与白石栏杆形成分层，庭院留白，树木靠边成簇。台地是建筑构筑物，地形高度由主城采样提供。
pois.detail_en: Nine narrowing terraces converge toward the summit. Vermilion walls, golden caps and marble rails define the tiers, while open courts and edge-planted trees preserve negative space. Terraces are architectural structures; the host supplies terrain heights.
pois.sim: 保留史诗尺度和九层骨架，不代表故宫测绘复原。
pois.sim_en: Preserves the epic scale and nine-tier structure; not a surveyed reconstruction of the Forbidden City.

pois.label: 山顶三重檐大殿
pois.detail: 主殿由同一 hall() 生成器构建，采用十一开间、三重檐与三层加高白石台基。南侧栏杆留出完整入口，最后一段白石阶接实体抵达平台；主殿仍是唯一最高建筑。
pois.detail_en: The shared hall() generator builds an eleven-bay summit hall with three eaves and three raised marble podium courses. South-side rail openings and a solid arrival court connect the final stairs. The hall remains the tallest building.
pois.sim: 建筑程序参数；比例为场景设计，不作真实工程结构承载结论。
pois.sim_en: Procedural scene parameters, not a structural engineering assessment.

pois.label: 钟鼓楼与塔楼族
pois.detail: 钟鼓楼分列中段台地两侧。外城四角的十字脊角楼、南端双阙、上段八角楼阁与小角亭作为竖向标点，不侵入中轴，也不争夺主殿的最高点。
pois.detail_en: Bell and drum towers flank a middle terrace. Four cross-ridged corner towers, paired southern watchtowers, upper octagonal pavilions and small corner pavilions punctuate the skyline without blocking the axis or overtaking the summit.
pois.sim: 夜景由引擎日照、nightMats 与注册点光源驱动；模块不添加环境光或平行光。
pois.sim_en: Night lighting uses the host sun, nightMats and registered point lights; the module adds no ambient or directional lights.
